list.name: run_id
list.definition: SELECT DISTINCT run_id FROM pulseboard.ads_pv_uv ORDER BY run_id
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT run_id FROM pulseboard.ads_pv_uv ORDER BY run_id

targets.rawSql: SELECT window_start AS time, pv, uv FROM pulseboard.ads_pv_uv FINAL WHERE run_id = '${run_id}' ORDER BY window_start
SELECT countIf(behavior = 'pv') AS late_pv FROM pulseboard.dwd_late_events FINAL WHERE run_id = '${run_id}'
SELECT count() AS duplicates FROM pulseboard.dwd_duplicate_events FINAL WHERE run_id = '${run_id}'

panels.title: 最近一个窗口的转化漏斗（用户数）

targets.rawSql: SELECT step, users FROM (SELECT * FROM (SELECT '浏览用户' AS step, toUInt64(pv_users) AS users, 1 AS ord FROM pulseboard.ads_funnel FINAL WHERE run_id = '${run_id}' ORDER BY window_start DESC LIMIT 1) UNION ALL SELECT * FROM (SELECT '加购且不早于浏览', toUInt64(pv_to_cart_users), 2 FROM pulseboard.ads_funnel FINAL WHERE run_id = '${run_id}' ORDER BY window_start DESC LIMIT 1) UNION ALL SELECT * FROM (SELECT '购买且不早于浏览', toUInt64(pv_to_buy_users), 3 FROM pulseboard.ads_funnel FINAL WHERE run_id = '${run_id}' ORDER BY window_start DESC LIMIT 1)) ORDER BY ord

panels.title: 最近窗口 Top 10 商品

targets.rawSql: SELECT rank, item_id, category_code, pv FROM pulseboard.ads_top_items FINAL WHERE run_id = '${run_id}' AND window_start = (SELECT max(window_start) FROM pulseboard.ads_top_items FINAL WHERE run_id = '${run_id}') ORDER BY rank

SELECT window_start AS time, category_code, pv FROM pulseboard.ads_category_pv FINAL WHERE run_id = '${run_id}' AND category_code IN (SELECT category_code FROM pulseboard.ads_category_pv FINAL WHERE run_id = '${run_id}' GROUP BY category_code ORDER BY sum(pv) DESC LIMIT 6) ORDER BY window_start

panels.title: 处理延迟 P50 / P99（毫秒）

targets.rawSql: SELECT round(quantile(0.5)(toUnixTimestamp64Milli(inserted_at) - toUnixTimestamp64Milli(produce_time)), 1) AS p50_ms, round(quantile(0.99)(toUnixTimestamp64Milli(inserted_at) - toUnixTimestamp64Milli(produce_time)), 1) AS p99_ms FROM pulseboard.ods_events FINAL WHERE run_id = '${run_id}'

panels.title: 实时 vs 离线（绝对差）

targets.rawSql: SELECT metric, count() AS windows, round(sum(abs_diff), 2) AS sum_abs_diff, round(max(abs_diff), 2) AS max_abs_diff FROM pulseboard.ads_reconcile FINAL WHERE run_id = '${run_id}' GROUP BY metric ORDER BY metric
